user.title: Marstek BLE
user.description: Read-only local BLE integration. CT002 polling defaults to 5 seconds. Intervals from 1 to 4 seconds are allowed but can significantly increase BLE/device load. Venus devices are optional and are polled separately at a slower interval.

data.venus_devices: Venus devices (one per line: Name=Bluetooth MAC)

data_description.ct_poll_interval: Default and recommended: 5 s. Allowed: 1 to 300 s.
data_description.venus_devices: Example: Battery 1=00:11:22:33:44:55. A name is optional; a bare MAC address is also accepted.

confirm_fast_poll.title: Confirm fast CT002 polling
confirm_fast_poll.description: You selected {seconds} seconds. Below {recommended} seconds, BLE and device load increase significantly and some CT002 units may become unstable. The integration deliberately does not impose a higher minimum. Submit to confirm that you want to use this interval at your own risk.

init.title: Marstek BLE options
init.description: Polling settings apply after saving and the integration reloads automatically. The CT002 default and recommendation is 5 seconds. Values from 1 to 4 seconds are allowed but require explicit confirmation before saving.
